People on scooter/motorcycle are fully drawn matching reference, hands on handlebars, legs on footrests. All 15 are complete side profiles, no missing or merged cells. Carefully consistent commercial game art, sharp fine pixels at high detail. The atlas must have alpha transparency, not a painted dark/checkerboard backdrop.

limitations: Opposite side uses a mirrored profile; this is directional pseudo-3D art, not separately authored asymmetric sides or a polygonal 360-degree mesh.
